newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul Harris buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul Harris buy repeated.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw said Tuesday it maintains its buy rating and its price target of $30 a share.
-- Paul Harris shares were down 1-1/16 at 15-15/16.
-- Paul Harris reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.62 a share, compared with $0.42 a year ago. Results were $0.04 above its estimate, Rodman said.
-- For the year, it earned $0.83 a share, up from $0.16 a year ago.

-- "We believe that these results are further evidence that the company is successfully identifying and meeting the needs and preferences of its customers through a merchandise offering with excellent quality, style and value," Rodman & Renshaw said in a report.
